title: Glupe Audit Report
description: Formal schema for the JSON report generated by the `glupe audit` command.

audit_passed.description: Indicates whether the implementation strictly matches the specification without any divergences.

divergence_detected.description: True if any structural or semantic divergences (missing, hallucinated, or mismatches) were found.

audit_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the audit was performed.

glupe_version.description: The version of the Glupe compiler that generated this report.

missing.description: A list of container IDs that are present in the specification but absent in the implementation.

hallucinated.description: A list of container IDs that are present in the implementation but undocumented in the specification.

mismatches.description: A list of logical mismatches between matched containers.

expected_container.description: The ID of the container in the specification.

actual_container.description: The ID of the corresponding mapped container in the implementation.

diff.description: The deep semantic subtraction diff detailing the missing or hallucinated logic within the container.

report_text.description: The full human-readable markdown report of the semantic subtraction.
